plots.title: When each neuron switches on
plots.description: Each row is one neuron. Brighter means it switches on for more of the same 1,024 test inputs. 151 saved states; real training-step spacing. Rows retain the same neuron order throughout. No retraining.

plots.title: Where learning leaves its mark
plots.description: Each row follows one neuron’s incoming weights, measured against their starting values. 0 = unchanged; 1 = change as large as the starting weight vector. Offsets excluded. Colors share one scale across all layers.

methods.activity: Fraction of the same fixed 1,024 test inputs with preactivation > 0 for each neuron.
methods.movement: Euclidean distance of incoming weight vector from its initial value, divided by the initial vector norm. Biases excluded.
methods.checkpoint_timing: Intermediate recorded steps precede their update, so completed steps = recorded step minus one. Final state follows all updates.
methods.rendering: Cell boundaries are halfway between measured training steps; checkpoint spacing is not assumed uniform.
